settings.title: Upload size
settings.summary: The largest file one upload may be.
settings.description: The largest file one upload may be, in bytes. A larger one is refused. Providers have limits of their own: the Anthropic Messages API takes an image of up to about 5 MB.

settings.title: Image types
settings.summary: The kinds of image a person may upload.
settings.description: The kinds of image a person may upload, as media types separated by commas. An image is known by its bytes, not its name, and goes only to a model whose registry entry says it can see images.

settings.title: Text file types
settings.summary: The kinds of text file a person may upload.
settings.description: The endings of the text files a person may upload, separated by commas. A text file must be UTF-8. Its text is read, and goes into a chat's calls as an attachment, to any model.

settings.title: Document types
settings.summary: The kinds of document a person may upload.
settings.description: The kinds of document a person may upload, as media types separated by commas, known by their bytes. Keystone reads no text from them yet: a document is sent whole, as a file, only to a model whose registry entry says it takes files.

settings.title: File text sent
settings.summary: How much of one attached file's text goes into a call.
settings.description: The most characters of one file's text that go into a call. The rest is left out, with a note. All attachments together take no more than chats.context_attached_percent of a call.

settings.title: Attached file heading
settings.summary: The line a model reads before an attached file's text.
settings.default: The person attached the file {name} to this chat. Its text:
settings.description: The line a call is given before a text file's text, with the attachments. {name} becomes the file's name.

settings.title: Attached file marker
settings.summary: What stands in your message where a file was attached.
settings.default: [The person attached the file {name} here. Its text is with the attachments, if it fitted.]
settings.description: What stands in the person's message where a text file was attached. {name} becomes the file's name.

settings.title: File cut note
settings.summary: What a model is told when an attached file was cut short.
settings.default: [The rest of {name}, {chars} more characters, is left out.]
settings.description: The line after a file's text that was cut to uploads.text_max_chars. {name} becomes the file's name and {chars} the number of characters left out.

settings.title: Image left out note
settings.summary: What a model that cannot see images is told instead.
settings.default: [The person attached an image here, {name}. It is not shown to you, because you cannot see images. If they ask about it, say so.]
settings.description: What a model that cannot see images is given in place of an image the person attached. {name} becomes the image's name.

settings.title: Document left out note
settings.summary: What a model that takes no files is told instead.
settings.default: [The person attached the file {name} here. It is not shown to you: Keystone cannot read its text, and you do not take files. If they ask about it, say so.]
settings.description: What a model that takes no files is given in place of a document the person attached. {name} becomes the file's name.
